desk.title: The night desk
desk.text: Your first night as the archive's watchman. At midnight the lights in the map room flicker and go out. Nerve {nerve}, Wits {wits}.

choices.text: Stay at the desk until morning

stairs.title: The stairs
stairs.text: The map room door is locked with a code. You have heard the curators mutter it. Can you remember?

choices.text: Try to remember the code (roll 1d6 + Wits, 7 or more)

alarm.title: The alarm
alarm.text: The keypad shrieks. Somewhere below, something that is not a curator starts up the stairs. Your nerve frays (-2 Nerve).

maps.title: The map room
maps.text: The door clicks open. A grey shape is rolling up the oldest map in the archive, as if to take it away.

shade.title: The shade
shade.text: It turns towards you: a shadow with ink-stained hands. You hold the torch up and keep your head.

dawn.title: Dawn
dawn.text: The shade comes apart like smoke in the torchlight. When the curators arrive, every map is in its drawer.

morning.title: Morning
morning.text: You sit tight until the sun comes up. In the map room, the oldest map is gone. Nobody blames you; nobody offers you a second night, either.
